bibliographic_record.title: Data-driven discovery of Koopman eigenfunctions for control
bibliographic_record.authors: Kaiser, E.; Kutz, J. N.; Brunton, B. W.

verbatim_excerpt: 'Finite-dimensional approximations of the Koopman operator are typically obtained as its projection onto a specified basis or dictionary... a well-known issue arises when trying to identify the full operator in a finite set of basis functions, that sometimes the finite-dimensional approximation is not closed and spurious eigenfunctions may appear.'
